content_digest_rule: sha256 of the canonical JSON of {schema, set, relation, n, ports, files without index.json}

recipe.admission: every BF16 output word finite (Subcircuit.admitted); instance i = the i-th admitted draw
recipe.draw: templates.Subcircuit.draw(key, j): each port's words from key.stream((port, j), 4 bytes per word)

samplers.cs: bf16 window: exponent field 120 +- h, h in [6] per draw; 1/32 edge words [0, 32768, 1, 32769, 16256, 49024] (|c|, |s| < 1)
samplers.x: bf16 window: exponent field 127 +- h, h in [4, 16] per draw; 1/32 edge words [0, 32768, 1, 32769, 16256, 49024]

provenance.selection: the first n admitted draws, in draw order

relation.rule: out[i] = bf16_rn(RN32(x[i]*c[i] - x[i+R]*s[i])), out[i+R] = bf16_rn(RN32(x[i+R]*c[i] + x[i]*s[i])), cs = [c | s], R = D/2
